response.explanation: Ruby has no method overloading. `def self.downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts={})` at line 149 replaces `def self.downsize(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts={})` at line 145. The existing caller in app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14 calls `OptimizedImage.downsize(path, path, 100, 100, opts)`. That call now binds dimensions=100 and opts=100, and the fifth argument raises ArgumentError because the method accepts at most four. A four-argument call such as `downsize(from, to, 100, 100)` would bind opts=100, and `opts[:allow_animation]` would then raise a TypeError. Either way, the width/height form no longer works.
response.title: Second `downsize` definition overwrites the width/height version, breaking existing callers
